description: Negative control for m25: a listening socket (its process is declared), undeclared. The observer before m25 did not see it.

inputs.agent: the dev VM's production-style system unit (opute-bootstrap-mcp.service), test identity e2e-devvm-agent, test bearer token

requirements.requirement: Harness: a listening socket (its process is declared) is an effect

steps.guest: setsid -f python3 -m http.server --bind 127.0.0.1 3999 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; for i in $(seq 50); do ss -ltnH 'sport = :3999' | grep -q . && break; sleep 0.2; done
